metadata.description: A player skin as a standing block statue, one block per texel at 1x.

toolField.name: scale
toolField.label: Scale
toolField.help: Blocks per texel. 1x is 32 blocks tall.

toolField.name: overlay
toolField.label: Outer layer
toolField.help: The hat and jacket layer of the skin.

toolField.name: overlay_parts
toolField.label: Outer layer parts
toolField.help: Choose which outer layers to include.

data.label: Load player skin
data.description: Fetch and decode the selected player skin. Geometry stays in the following nodes.

data.label: Resolve block palette
data.description: Apply the preset, additions and exclusions using Nucleation.Palette and PaletteBuilder.

data.label: Unwrap skin onto statue
data.description: Map each opaque skin texel to a surface voxel. Edit the UV layout, limbs, scale and outer-layer rules here.

data.label: Match colours to blocks
data.description: Use Nucleation’s colour matcher, then apply the selected block replacements.

data.label: Place schematic blocks
data.description: Create a native schematic and place each batch of blocks.

data.label: Measure schematic
data.description: Read dimensions and block counts directly from the generated schematic.

data.label: Encode selected format
data.description: The format input controls this native export operation and the downloadable file.
